cnd18:5.1: jātakasatāni → pañca jātisatāni (sī.pana) | mahāpadāniyasuttaṃ → suttantaṃ (machasaṃ) | māghadeviyasuttaṃ → magha deviya suttantaṃ (sa); maghā deviya suttantaṃ (sī.pana)
